name: brewpluse
description: BrewPluse - Run your cafe. Not your software. Modern Cafe Management & POS System

scripts.mobile:build: powershell -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME = 'D:\BrewPluse\.tools\jdk17\jdk-17.0.20.1+1'; $env:ANDROID_HOME = 'D:\BrewPluse\.tools\android-sdk'; cd android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug; Copy-Item app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk ..\public\BrewPluse-Android.apk -Force; Copy-Item app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk ..\public\downloads\BrewPluse-Android.apk -Force"
